title: Project Manager 2
description:
Role: Project Manager 2
Location: Santa Clara, California, USA
Type: Full-Time | Hybrid (1 day work from home)

Job Summary
Our client, a leading construction organization, is seeking a Project Manager 2 to oversee moderately complex construction projects and support overall project execution, scheduling, financial management, and stakeholder coordination.

Key Responsibilities
  • Manage project schedules, budgets, procurement, and subcontractors.
  • Lead project meetings, change management, and closeout activities.
  • Coordinate with architects, engineers, owners, vendors, and field teams.
  • Monitor project profitability, forecasting, and risk mitigation.
  • Support preconstruction efforts including bidding and buyout schedules.
  • Maintain project documentation and compliance standards.

Requirements
  • Bachelor's degree in Construction Management, Engineering, or related field.
  • 7+ years of construction management experience.
  • Strong expertise in scheduling, cost control, and project execution.
  • Advanced proficiency with project management and scheduling software.
  • Strong communication and stakeholder management skills.

Preferred Skills
  • Lean construction methodology experience.
  • Risk analysis and subcontractor management.
  • Commercial construction project experience.
  • Construction technology platform expertise.

Certifications
  • Valid and unrestricted driver's license required.

title: Senior Electrical Engineer
description:
Role: Senior Electrical Engineer – Digital Hardware Design
Location: Rochester, NY
Type: Full-Time | Onsite

Job Summary
Our client, a leading aerospace and defense communications organization, is seeking a Senior Electrical Engineer to support the development of next-generation Software Defined Radio (SDR) platforms and embedded communication systems.

Key Responsibilities
  • Lead embedded digital hardware design and integration activities
  • Support ARM core, DDR memory, Ethernet, and USB system development
  • Conduct simulation, signal integrity, and verification analysis
  • Develop PCB schematics and support layout review processes
  • Execute subsystem and system-level testing activities
  • Collaborate with RF, firmware, and software engineering teams
  • Support manufacturing transition and field deployment activities

Requirements
  • Bachelor's Degree in Electrical or Computer Engineering
  • 6+ years of digital hardware design experience
  • Experience with embedded microprocessor systems and high-speed interfaces
  • Familiarity with oscilloscopes, logic analyzers, and test equipment
  • Ability to obtain and maintain U.S. Security Clearance

Preferred Skills
  • SDR architecture experience
  • RF systems integration knowledge
  • Python, VHDL, or embedded scripting experience
  • LTSpice, HyperLynx, MATLAB, Agile PLM familiarity
  • MIL-STD-461 and IPC standards experience

title: Principal Counsel (Aviation / ISR)
description:

Location: Greenville/Plano/Rockwall County/Waco, TX
Type: FTE/Permanent

    • Government / DoD contracts

title: Principal Hardware Systems Engineer
description:
Role: Principal Hardware Systems Engineer – FPGA & Defense Electronics
Location: Canonsburg, PA
Type: Full-Time | 100% Onsite

This position will provide technical leadership for advanced hardware architectures, multidisciplinary engineering integration, and mission-critical defense systems development.

  • Participate in hardware, firmware, and software design trade studies and reviews
  • Support design analysis, simulation, verification, and documentation

title: Metallurgical Engineer
